name: update
short: Check for a newer stable release; upgrade Homebrew only with --apply

flags.name: apply
flags.usage: Upgrade a detected Homebrew installation after confirmation

flags.name: quiet
flags.usage: Hide notes, hints and progress on stderr; never hide errors or the answer

flags.name: select
flags.usage: Comma-separated fields to include in JSON output (e.g. --select response)

side_effects: checks GitHub for the latest stable release only when explicitly invoked, with a 10s timeout and no automatic checks or retries
with --apply, runs brew upgrade kamenxrider/tap/hollis only for a detected Homebrew install after confirmation; non-interactive modes require --yes; never runs the installer
